_comment: Site-wide config. Anything null is intentionally unset — see RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md. SITE_URL env var (or Netlify's URL) overrides siteUrl at build time.
title: BarberRome | Bay Area Rapper | Vallejo & San Francisco
description: BarberRome is a Bay Area rapper from San Francisco living in Vallejo. Stream BAY PLAY, TOP DOWN, Funky Flow and more. Barber and rapper.

hero.loopVideoNote: Optional: path to a 6–10s muted MP4 (H.264, <1.5 MB) cut from cruise footage, e.g. /assets/video/hero-loop.mp4
hero.stillCaptionMobile: Still from the ALL I KNOW video

reward.label: an unreleased cut or a voice note from the shop
reward._note: Set url to the private file/page once it exists. Until then the thank-you page says it isn't posted yet.

forms._modes: netlify = Netlify Forms (default). function = POST JSON to the Netlify functions relay. formsubmit = native POST to FormSubmit (formsubmit.co), which emails each submission; needs formsubmitEndpoint + one-time activation by the inbox owner. disabled = no forms (GitHub Pages default).
forms._formsubmitNote: Endpoint set. formsubmitActive stays false until the inbox owner clicks FormSubmit's activation email; while false the forms say delivery is still being set up. Flip to true after confirmation and push.

analytics._note: Events always go to window.dataLayer. Paste a provider snippet into src/partials/analytics.html if you want one.
